name: Jyoti Resins and Adhesives Ltd
about: Jyoti Resins And Adhesives Ltd. is a manufacturer of synthetic resin adhesives. The company manufactures various types of wood adhesives (white glue), under the brand name of EURO 7000 , which was launched in 2006, and is now the second largest selling wood adhesive brand in India in the retail segment.
keyPoints:
Market Leadership
The company’s brand Euro 7000 is the 2nd largest wood adhesive white glue brand in India in the retail segment. [1]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 56.4% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 44.8%
Promoter holding has increased by 3.06% over last quarter.
Company's median sales growth is 27.4% of last 10 years
cons: Company has high debtors of 161 days.
